lines.zh: 我的关节转起来比旧型顺。
lines.en: My joints turn smoother than the old model.

lines.zh: 我一步一步踩过废铁堆。
lines.en: I tramp across the scrap heap.

lines.zh: 我的装甲缝里还在冒热气。
lines.en: Steam still rises from my armor seams.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，走得很稳。
lines.en: I keep my weight low and walk steadily.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌压得地面直响。
lines.en: My soles make the ground ring.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根倒下的柱子。
lines.en: I step around a fallen pillar.
I adjust the counterweight on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，是在校平衡。
lines.en: I pause each step to rebalance.

lines.zh: 我的核心在胸口低低地鸣。
lines.en: My core hums low in my chest.

lines.zh: 我的关节比旧型号顺多了。
lines.en: My joints turn smoother than the old model.

lines.zh: 我的关节上还留着旧划痕。
lines.en: Old scratches remain on my joints.
I walk in your direction.

lines.zh: 我站着，散热口一张一合。
lines.en: I stand, vents opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我在校准自己的传感器。
lines.en: I'm calibrating my sensors.

lines.zh: 胸口的石头碎片在发亮。
lines.en: The stone shard in my chest glows.
My engine runs evenly.

lines.zh: 我把手臂抬起来，又放下。
lines.en: I lift an arm, then lower it.

lines.zh: 这具身体比上一具好用。
lines.en: This body serves better than the last.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的金属摩擦声。
lines.en: I hear distant metal grinding.
I wait for my pilot to start me.

lines.zh: 我的装甲上有我自己的编号。
lines.en: My armor bears my own number.
I tilt my head slowly to one side.

lines.zh: 这里的空气里有铁锈味。
lines.en: There's rust in the air here.
I count the cracks in the ground.
My lights blink on and off.
I'm checking the hydraulics in my left leg.
This place would make a good range.

lines.zh: 我静下来，只有风扇在响。
lines.en: I go quiet; only the fans sound.
I've scanned you once over.

lines.zh: 你比上一具机体小得多。
lines.en: You're much smaller than the last frame.
My optics are on you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，不构成威胁。
lines.en: What you hold is no threat.
I'm no longer the prototype.
Step back; I'm calibrating.

lines.zh: 你不该站在我的行进线上。
lines.en: You shouldn't stand in my path.

lines.zh: 我的声音是从胸腔出来的。
lines.en: My voice comes from my chest cavity.
Your heart is beating fast.

lines.zh: 我在想，你值不值得启动。
lines.en: I'm deciding whether you're worth powering up for.

lines.zh: 这附近还有别的机体吗。
lines.en: Are there other frames nearby?

lines.zh: 我的核心石，比 Mk1 更厚。
lines.en: My core stone is thicker than Mk1's.

lines.zh: 我的装甲缝里还有旧漆。
lines.en: There's old paint in my armor seams.
If you'd speak, speak louder.

lines.zh: 凹痕里，露出新换的合金。
lines.en: Through the dent, the new alloy shows.
My readings are jumping.
The joint hydraulics are leaking.
I step back and rebalance.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我偏了三十度。
lines.en: That knocked me thirty degrees off.
My core temperature is climbing.
Vents wide open, still hot.
The plate holds; something inside clanks.
I lock out the damaged component.
I can still move. Don't rush.
I want that core shard.
I can sense that energy.
I take half a step, then pull it back.
Give me a reason to power up.
I reach out, then withdraw.
That charge would move me a while.
I turn toward the light source.
You've raised it higher.
My vents have opened wider.
A little closer and I can take it.

lines.zh: 你撞在膝甲上，我几乎没动。
lines.en: You hit my knee plate; I barely move.

lines.zh: 我的护甲把你的肩膀顶开。
lines.en: My plate shoves your shoulder aside.
The Mk2 core has been swapped once.
Don't push; my weight sits forward.
We collide and your boots slide.
I brace on the wall and a brick breaks.
My knee scrapes your elbow.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的读数乱了一下。
lines.en: That jostled my readings.

lines.zh: 关节锁死，我像根钉在原地。
lines.en: My joints lock; I stand nailed in place.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的落脚点，快让开。
lines.en: You are in my footfall; move.

lines.zh: 另一具机体停在我旁边。
lines.en: Another frame stops beside me.

lines.zh: 我们的核心频率对上了。
lines.en: Our core frequencies align.
Its number is older than mine.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一段校验码。
lines.en: We exchange a checksum.

lines.zh: 两副装甲靠在一起，很凉。
lines.en: Two plates lean together, cold.
Its joints are quieter than mine.
Together we align our bearings.

lines.zh: 我们的灯同步闪了两下。
lines.en: Our lights blink twice in sync.
It's more complete than I. I envy that.

lines.zh: 我们一起等下一道指令。
lines.en: Together we wait for the next command.
I clamp onto a plate of armor.
This shard fits my chest.
I stow the part in my bay.

lines.zh: 我拾起来，读了一下成分。
lines.en: I pick it up and read its composition.
This could buy me a joint.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰后的格子。
lines.en: I slot it behind my waist.
It's heavy. I like that.

lines.zh: 核心石碎片，我收进胸口。
lines.en: I slot the core shard into my chest.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前转了转。
lines.en: I hold it up and turn it.
This still works; I'll keep it.
Boot sequence, target confirmed.
You touched my core.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋亮了，我的灯也亮了。
lines.en: The spawn egg glows; so do my lights.
All my plates lock down.
This model is faster than the last.
I set the counterweight to combat.

lines.zh: 你退后也没用，核心石已经热了。
lines.en: Retreating will not help; my core stone is hot.
My vents are speeding up.

lines.zh: 核心的温度升到战斗值。
lines.en: Core temperature climbs to combat level.
This isn't a test.
Core output is rising.

lines.zh: 核心石换成碎片，我就动了。
lines.en: The core stone split to shards, and I moved.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，我已经算好了。
lines.en: I've already calculated your position.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上有旧的战损。
lines.en: My armor carries old battle damage.
I close in an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 你的动作我提前读到了。
lines.en: I read your move ahead of time.

lines.zh: 强化后的腿，跨一步就到侧翼。
lines.en: My upgraded legs reach your flank in one stride.

lines.zh: 我的传感器全部对着你。
lines.en: Every sensor is on you.
I'm computing your stride.
Don't run; I'm steadier than you.
My joints click faster and faster.
The wall has you pinned there.

lines.zh: 我把手臂抬到合适的高度。
lines.en: I raise my arm to the right height.
Two more meters and you're in range.

lines.zh: 你改向，我的配重跟着调。
lines.en: You turn; my counterweight follows.
I know this ground.
My core is at the right temperature.
Back to the wall. Clever.
I wait for your first mistake.
My fist slams beside your feet.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着整机的重量。
lines.en: That punch carries my whole weight.
The sweep spins you around.

lines.zh: 我的前臂顶住你的胸口。
lines.en: My forearm pins your chest.

lines.zh: 你退开后，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: Where you stood, the ground gave way.

lines.zh: 我的关节响了一声，没事。
lines.en: A joint cracked. Nothing serious.
That loosened your grip.
I lift my foot and my shadow covers you.
You land in the scrap.
I pull back; my readings hold.
Someone has set down the summoning item.

lines.zh: 我的启动灯一盏盏亮起。
lines.en: My startup lights come on one by one.

lines.zh: 强化骨架展开，比 Mk1 高一头。
lines.en: My upgraded frame unfolds, a head taller than Mk1.
I rise from standby.
The hatch pops and I step out.

lines.zh: 空气里多了一股润滑油味。
lines.en: The air gains a smell of machine oil.
My number flashes on the screen.
The fans start to turn.
My feet sink into the mud.
I shake the dust off my shoulders.
The core ignites for the first time.

lines.zh: 我站直，比周围的石头高。
lines.en: I stand taller than the stones around me.
One more frame in this area.
I wait for the boot sequence to finish.
Fire bubbles the paint on my plate.
I fall from height and my leg buckles.
Water gets into my hydraulics and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀得翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打穿了我的肩甲。
lines.en: Something punches through my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 法术让我的仪表全乱了。
lines.en: That spell sends every gauge wild.
Power is draining; I can barely stand.
Lightning overloads me; all my lights flash.

lines.zh: 虚空拽住我的脚，我悬空了。
lines.en: The void grips my foot and I hang in nothing.
